name: OWOX Data Marts
description:
OWOX Data Marts connects Claude to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted Data Marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena).

From Claude you can:
• Discover the right data mart for any question with natural-language semantic search
• Inspect a mart's fields, metrics, and joinable dimensions
• Query governed data and get answers with server-side totals — computed from analyst-defined metrics and joins, never guessed from raw tables
• See available destinations and manage recurring report run schedules

Every answer comes from analyst-approved definitions, so metrics stay consistent and joins are never hallucinated. Your data stays in your own warehouse — OWOX connects to it but never retains it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OWOX Data Marts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OWOX Data Marts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.owox.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OWOX Data Marts MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OWOX Data Marts lists 18 MCP tools, including create_report_run_schedule, delete_report_run_schedule, get_data_mart_details_by_id, get_data_mart_reports, get_project_context, get_relevant_data_marts_by_prompt, list_data_marts, list_destinations, list_report_run_schedules, query_data_mart, update_report_run_schedule, and add_destination.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OWOX Data Marts?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OWOX Data Marts in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does OWOX Data Marts MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: OWOX Data Marts requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OWOX Data Marts is developed by OWOX. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
